newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam War-era shell explodes, kills 4 children.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam War-era shell explodes, kills 4 children.

text.p: Four children were killed and another seriously injured playing with a Vietnam War-era shell in a province near Ho Chi Minh City.
Police in Dong Nai province said on Friday that the children -- four boys and a girl aged between eight and 12 years -- had picked up the shell and were playing a game with it when it exploded.
The boys were killed instantly. The girl was still in hospital, a week after the incident took place, police told Reuters.
Unexploded ordnance from the Vietnam War remains a deadly hazard and dozens of people are killed each year, many of them while trying to defuse bombs to sell as scrap metal.
In April, seven children were killed and more than 30 injured when a fragmentation bomb exploded in the grounds of a school in the Central Highlands.
